user.title: Add a Heatit WiFi Panel
user.description: Enter the address of the panel on your network. Home Assistant reads the panel's status once to learn which unit it is.

data_description.host: The panel's IP address or hostname. Give the panel a static DHCP reservation on your router so its address does not move.

reconfigure.title: Change the panel's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the panel's new address. This only moves this panel; a unit that replaced it has to be added as a new device.

data_description.host: The panel's IP address or hostname.

error.cannot_connect: Nothing answered at that address. Check that the panel is powered on and on your network, and that the address is right.
error.invalid_response: Something answered at that address, but it is not a Heatit WiFi Panel.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up. To move a panel that has changed address, use Reconfigure on the existing entry instead of adding it again.
abort.already_in_progress: This panel is already being set up.
abort.not_configured: The panel at that address is not set up in Home Assistant.
abort.wrong_panel: A different panel answered at that address. This entry is for panel {expected_id}, but {actual_id} answered. A panel that has been replaced must be added as a new device rather than adopted here — its history belongs to the old unit.

data_description.poll_interval: How often Home Assistant reads the panel's status, in seconds. Minimum 30. Changes you make in Home Assistant show up immediately; this governs how quickly changes made on the panel itself, in the MyHeatit app, or by open window detection are noticed. Changing it reloads the panel.

invalid_response.message: The panel's answer could not be read: {error}

missing_field.message: The panel's status is missing {field}, without which its state cannot be described.

foreign_panel.message: A different panel answered at this address. This entry is for panel {expected_id}, but {actual_id} answered. Change the address with Reconfigure, or add the new panel as its own device.
